issues.detail: Error handling is covered for masking and depth limits, but there is no worked example for rate limiting (the @rateLimit directive and identifyFn are described but never shown), uploads, or Redis-backed multi-instance setups, and Example 2 uses undefined typeDefs/resolvers.

scenarios.name: users-api-sse-subscription-masked-errors
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely, with default error masking left on, GraphQLError NOT_FOUND, createPubSub, and no WebSocket server. B overrides maskedErrors with a custom maskError, which the rubric says not to do (it asks to leave default masking on), though B's other parts are correct.

scenarios.name: response-cache-and-depth-limit-with-fetch-test
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely (ttl 60_000, per-user authorization session, maxDepth 8, POST yoga.fetch with JSON body) while B uses maxDepth 7, a custom x-user header session, and messy leftover helper code, deviating from the rubric's maxDepth 8 despite correct packages and fetch testing.

scenarios.name: file-upload-and-rate-limit-multi-replica
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric closely: it declares scalar File, takes a File! argument, reads it with file.text(), uses useRateLimiter with identifyFn, defines the @rateLimit directive with max 10 and window 5s, and notes in-memory PubSub and cache are per-process while recommending the Redis event target and a shared cache. A uses a File! argument and the Redis event target and shared cache, but it never declares scalar File, uses rate-limiter-flexible instead of @envelop/rate-limiter, and has no @rateLimit directive or useRateLimiter.
